review_candidates.title: Enterprise Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Inotiv is seeking an experienced Enterprise Infrastructure Engineer to design, deploy, and maintain our virtualized server infrastructure across Windows and Linux environments. Key Accountabilities Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise virtualization environments (VMware vSphere/ESXi, Hyper-V, or similar) as well as supporting Microsoft Azure-hosted virtual infrastructure. Administer core Windows Server services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, File/Print services) and standard Linu
eligibility_evidence: Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure administration (e.g., virtual machines, storage, networking, and resource groups) sufficient to support hybrid on-premises/Azure infrastructure; deep or expert-level Azure architecture experience is not required for this role.
Preferences Relevant certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator, CompTIA Linux+/Server+, or RHCSA.
Additional exposure to AWS and hybrid cloud/on-premises virtualization strategies.

It is our policy to provide a fair and equal employment opportunity to all persons, regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role focused on the health, performance, and security of our virtualization platforms and the enterprise systems that run on them, performed in a remote capacity. Collaborate with security, networking, and application teams to ensure infrastructure meets compliance, availability, and performance requirements. Other special projects and duties as assigned Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and experience considered. 3+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, or equivalent).
